description: Defines the ConditionalDataBar class used for handling conditional formatting data bars in PHPSpreadsheet library. The class manages properties like showValue, minimum and maximum value objects, color, and extension data relevant to data bar conditional formatting.

classes.name: ConditionalDataBar
classes.description: Represents a data bar conditional formatting rule for spreadsheet styling, encapsulating properties like show value, min/max objects, color, and extension data.

methods.name: getShowValue
methods.description: Retrieves whether the data bar's value should be shown.

methods.name: setShowValue
methods.description: Sets whether the data bar's value should be shown.

methods.name: getMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Gets the minimum value object for the data bar.

methods.name: setMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the minimum value object for the data bar.

methods.name: getMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Gets the maximum value object for the data bar.

methods.name: setMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the maximum value object for the data bar.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Retrieves the color used for the data bar.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color used for the data bar.

methods.name: getConditionalFormattingRuleExt
methods.description: Gets the extension data related to the conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: setConditionalFormattingRuleExt
methods.description: Sets the extension data related to the conditional formatting rule.
